200878.overview: An unreleased shooter game by Ocean on Amiga. This game was released as Steel Machine in 1993 on the CD-i.

200883.overview: It has been over 30 years since the classic game STARQUAKE was released on the ZX Spectrum and at long last Commodore Amiga owners have their very own version of the game! The Amiga conversion of Starquake is officially endorsed by Steve Crow and is based on the Atari ST version of the game. The Amiga version features extra enhancements including a new intro sequence featuring new presentation screens and enhanced music on the front-end.

200902.overview:
Based on the air hockey sub-game of the 1987 DesignStar/Mindscape C64/128 release of SPORTTIME SUPERSTAR INDOOR SPORTS (aka INDOOR SPORTS).
Ported from 1987 DesignStar/Mindscape Amiga release of the same game.

200913.overview:
Based on the ten pin bowling sub-game of the 1987 DesignStar/Mindscape C64/128 release of SPORTTIME SUPERSTAR INDOOR SPORTS (aka INDOOR SPORTS).
Ported from 1987 DesignStar/Mindscape Amiga release of the same game.

201570.overview: Inspired by the classic Japanese platformers from Konami/Hudson Soft but also with modern elements from games like Katana Zero and Dead Cells. This is a charming little platformer that will feature lovely background detail, smooth scrolling, coin collection, different enemies and multiple areas. For those of you who want to know about the changes in this test download : There's new enemies such as frogs, rolling stones and birds, new platform objects, new interactables including an Amiga and a fridge, new house and levels, and more for you to discover.

201571.overview:
One of a series of educational titles from Scetlander, 'Spellbound!' is quite unusual because it is an educational arcade shooter, and not a puzzle or an adventure game.

We play as Hal, who is the American cousin of Henrietta (from 'Hooray for Henrietta' and 'Henrietta's Book of Spells' fame). Henrietta asked us to help her in her dealing with Morgana the Morbid. That witch has given her magical wand to a twisted genius Professor Grime - a typical mad scientist - who has concealed it in his safe locked with five locks. Correspondingly, we are to find five keys on five levels: Underground, Underwater, Downtown, Alaska and Space Base.

The object of the game is to fly (or swim) a helicopter (or a submarine, or a space ship) through levels filled with obstacles and Professor Grime's henchmen: they shoot at us and we shoot at them, and after they die they leave us each a letter that we have to collect in specific order to spell a certain word (displayed as a task before the start of a level). The game features nice graphics and music, and even some voiceovers.

205419.overview:
Smash is a rather unusual tennis game, in that it is played from a 2D side view and therefore players cannot move sideways: in that respect it bears similarities with the Super Volleyball games. The player can move forwards or backwards as well as jump. When hitting the ball, the controller can be moved to influence the height and strength of the shot, obviously not the trajectory due to the limitations of the view. The camera always follows the ball, therefore the players are not always visible: a mini-map keeps track of the positions of each player and of the ball.

Four male and four female players are selectable, each with their own statistics and nationalities. The available game modes are single match and knockout tournament. The number of sets and games per set are customizable in single matches, however they progressively increase as the player advances through the tournament.

The Amiga version has a few unique features, such as team matches and a training mode against a ball machine. It also implements a fatigue system that is represented by a stamina bar for each player, which depletes if the player moves too much and may negatively influence the ability to run and the strength of shots.

205513.overview: An update or mod for Sensible World of Soccer bringing it up to date, adding a speedrun mode, a practice mode, HD widescreen and USB controller support. Requires original SWOS install to function.

205601.overview:
Syndicate: American Revolt is an expansion set designed for the Bullfrog strategy game Syndicate. During the game, the player leads a four-man team of cyborgs through the streets of a dark, dystopian world and through 21 difficult missions.

The game takes place during the 22nd century, after the events of Syndicate. The entire world is controlled by a megacorporation called Eurocorp. The company has become extremely wealthy and powerful after inventing the CHIP, which is a cybernetic implant capable of altering the perceptions of human beings so that the reality of a dystopia is perceived as a utopia.

The citizens of North and South America, tired of high taxes and dangerous streets, are rebelling against Eurocorp control to regain their autonomy. Rival Syndicates are using the revolt as the ideal opportunity to gain the upper hand in the ongoing struggle for supremacy. The player takes the role of a Eurocorp Syndicate executive, and the main objective of the game is to stop a massive revolt in the Americas that threatens the very existence of Eurocorp.

207221.overview: Simulman 04: Il Mondo Simulato is an Italian 2D single screen - flip screen action adventure game, developed by Natale Fietta and Stefano Balzani and published by Simulmondo, which was released in Europe in 1993. In English the title means The Simulated World.

207222.overview: Simulman 05: I Rapitori Di Sogni is an Italian 2D single screen - flip screen action adventure game, developed by Natale Fietta and Stefano Balzani and published by Simulmondo, which was released in Europe in 1993. In English the title means The Dream Captors.

207223.overview:
Simulman 07: Il Grande Freddo is an Italian 2D single screen - flip screen action adventure game, developed by Fabio Belletti, Natale Fietta and Stefano Balzani and published by Simulmondo, which was released in Europe in 1993. Simulman must arrest drug traffickers including The Great Cold or The Great Cold One as the title would be translated in English.  
 
Blessed are you who interact for pleasure. Not that I simulate by compulsion: only when I am faced with an adventure like this one of Simulman that you have in front of you, seriously I would like to know nothing else but to personally enjoy the action. But someone needs to create an adventure like this. Okay, in spite of myself I must rise to the occassion and satisfy you needs. In short, in this simulated story I decided to tell the past of Simul. Something you may have seen coming, and something that may not bring delight. However, the choice to become a virtual agent is not one taken at random. Let's say that the city understood that the threat of the Doors was real now. And that the simulations could become more disturbing and harmful of real reality. And so love and hate, good and evil are certainly no longer unreal and less exciting just because they are virtual. So here you will discover, interacting with enthusiasm and passion I hope, many things about the past life of the Simulmans and we will understand together why he is so determined to eradicate SS-DOS and its simulated creatures, including The Great Cold.

207224.overview: Simulman 08: Il Giardino Virtuale is an Italian, single screen - flip screen, action adventure game, developed by Fabio Belletti, Natale Fietta and Stefano Balzani and published by Simulmondo, which was released in Europe in 1993.

207225.overview: Simulman 9: Il Giocattolaio is an Italian, single screen -flip screen, action adventure game, developed by Fabio Belletti, Natale Fietta and Stefano Balzani and published by Simulmondo, which was released in Europe in 1993. In English the game is titled The Toymaker this was released in the Christmas season in Italy.

207226.overview: Simulman 10: Pentagram is an Italian, action adventure game, developed and published by Simulmondo, which was released in Europe in 1994. Your character, Simulman a character based on a primary developer, named Venturi and Jim Morrison! You gain points through the elimination of who will try to kill you: each opponent killed will make you increase the score that will appear at the top of the screen. Along the way there are other apparently useless items that will increase your score to find and gather.

207227.overview: A 2D action adventure written by Natale Fietta and Stefano Balzani for Simulmondo it Europe in 1994. This month's adventure, the installment "Jailhouse Rock" is the door of maximum security prison from where Simulman suspects, our foes are leaving orders for the worst crimes committed in the city. Under false credentials, our agent, yes will have to infiltrate inside the virtual prison ...

207307.overview:
StarSettlers is a menu-based strategy game in which the player has to conquer 50 solar systems (each one representing a level) with up to eight planets each.

Colonies need resources, technology and people. The player's job is to set details like birthrate and money distribution to reach the required economical balance for the colony to thrive. The progression is measured in various numbers like evolution rate or intelligence. Because the other planets don't stand still, it is useful to think of defenses. When another planet is conquered, it requires the same amount of management as the first, all while the clock is ticking in real-time.

207377.overview: Released shortly after the war in Iraq of 1991 had begun, The Saddam Hussein Game is a platform shooter that attempts to take advantage of the mood of much of the English speaking world and translate that into sales. You are a special forces agent with the mission to find and capture Saddam Hussein. The intro uses digitized stills from TV news reporting of the time.

207399.overview: Sensible Train Spotting is the world's first ever computerized train spotting simulator. The game takes place at a railway station, with a view looking over the train platforms. Various trains pass through, each bearing a unique ID number. At the bottom of the screen is a checklist of train ID numbers, each of which must be selected by the player as the corresponding train appears. This must be done against a time limit, and attempting to record an incorrect number will result in a penalty. When all trains in the checklist have been spotted, the game moves on to the next level.

208028.overview:
Sensible World of Soccer 2021/22 is a feature-packed version of Sensible Soccer that is sure to be enjoyed by gamers of any age!
For those of you who love playing on the Commodore Amiga, you'll also be pleased to know league and competition structure of 96/97 has been maintained to be compatible with real Amiga machines, and even though HDF/WHDLOAD versions are available with slightly edited in-game graphics, and updated teams, the database has been updated to 21/22, career mode is working, the year has been set to 21/22 and the HDF requires at least an Amiga 600/1200 and 4 MB Fastram!

210603.overview: During the 1998 World Cup in France the Cresswell brothers made a special update, which was based on '97/'98 and contained also some new graphics. This "World Cup 98 update" was officially supported by Sensible Software and released on the Cover CD number 24 of the magazine "CU Amiga". But to use this update a hard disk installation was required which officially does not exist.

210604.overview: After SWOS development ended in 1996, some fan projects tried to keep SWOS up-to-date, like the Cresswell brothers from England who collected data from several internet forums and created an unofficial update to '97/'98 for Amiga.

211259.overview:
A Worm\Snake game developed by Mehmet Ali Sahin of Backyard Brothers. It has improved graphics and lots of fun extras. 
 A level editor was available for registered users. There are over 100 levels spread over 25 worlds. And all has its own theme/graphics. Fun Pac-Man and Lemmings animations, the powerups and that you receive a password when you have completed a world.

211317.overview:
Putting the basic visual style from Sensible Soccer to a new use, Sensible Massacre sets you as an England goalkeeper faced with hordes of Dutch strikers running towards you (as a patriotic dig after the Dutch football team prevented the English one from qualifying for the 1994 World Cup). You are armed with an infinite supply of bombs, and must use these to kill the guys before they can reach the goal-line. They are aimed by using a crosshair controlled by the mouse, and fired with the left button. It's essentially Missile Command, so aiming the bombs slightly in front of where the players are at that moment, so as to allow for the time the bomb takes to explode and the distance the strikers can travel in that time. Bombs leave craters in the pitch, although these don't appear to affect the motion of the players, and is purely cosmetic.

You can choose how long the game lasts, how fast the opposition is, and the color of the pitch. After the game, you are told how many players are 'home' (killed by you) and how many are 'away' (reached the goal-line successfully); the observant among you will notice the Cannon Fodder overlap.

211318.overview: This game is a sequel to Sensible Massacre  (England v Holland) also created by James Hall and is another spoof of Sensible Soccer. It was featured on Amiga Action 70, disk 3. You can choose how long the game lasts, how fast the opposition is, and the color of the pitch. After the game, you are told how many players are 'home' (killed by you) and how many are 'away' (reached the goal-line successfully).

211367.overview: Similar to Super Cars, this overhead racing game, made in Blitz BASIC,  features the talent of Insane Software . A good quality game, the races can get a bit chaotic and there are some tricky tracks. The quick races make it fun.

211368.overview:
In this Star Wars inspired game you are given 4 ships to make your way through the battle area of the moon of Endor. This game was released as shareware (DEMO version) initially. It planned that additional levels would be presented after send 15 USD and register as a member. 
However, no levels were added because the coder was employed as another commercial games' coder

211370.overview: A multi-scrolling cave shooter with the ability to shoot through walls. Blast and bomb your way through many obstacles to save the survivors.

211416.overview:
It's Holiday Season again and when it comes to deliver presents for good, Santa disappears like snow under the sun, so all the hard work is on the poor Super Delivery Boy.

Help him deliver as many presents as possible so he doesn't get fired! But be careful, the kids have their own preference about what to receive and the path to reach them is full of wierd creatures.

Pick up the presents by the color requested by the kids. Delivering the wrong one will give you less points! You can use non matching presents as weapon by tossing them against the enemies, but again, be careful with colors!

211427.overview:
A homebrew multiscrolling platform game by José A. González (Jojo 073) with music by Ricardo Vieira. You drive Capacitartor on his mission to repair capacitors that are about to explode, you must look for them through several scenarios.  The game is presented in 3 stages. 
1-The base plate
 You must beware of virus infected discs, other malicious computer programs, bad cables and sharp elements.

2-Workbench
Searching for programs infected by the virus so that they can continue to function properly. Watch out for the dangers.

3-The sea of ​​acid
The most dangerous place, where acid destroys the condensers. Rescue the cautious condensers and destroy the evil that is right behind this attempt to destroy the Amiga universe.

211461.overview: A German language Amiga game based on the C64/Plus 4, side-view, motorcycle racing game, Kickstart. Jump the ramps, logs and other obstacles. Use the springs to get extra height. Get to the finish line before you run out of time. Super Kikstart is mailware. If you mail the author you will obtain the level editor.

211469.overview:
This game could easily be disregarded as just yet another Scorched Earth clone. But with the improved graphics and sound offered by the Amiga, and a huge array of weapons to buy, it's an excellent game in its own right.
Up to 4 players can battle it out against each other, or computer opponents, through multiple rounds. Players earn money by damaging each other, which they can then spend on weapons and shields between each round.

211476.overview: A collect and avoid, shooter game where you can play as either Santa or Rudolph. They both play exactly the same, as far as I could tell, and the only difference is the levels are the same when playing as Rudolph but in a new order and have new names.  Your goal is to fly around the level, shoot enemies, and deliver all presents within the time limit. Similar to Bombjack, enemies turn into deadlier versions of themselves when the timer runs out.

211488.overview:
Amiga conversion reverse engineered from the Atari ST release, conversion work done by Philippe Guichardon (Meynaf). Special attention was given to adding HD and additional French Language support over the original.

Take to the high seas as Sinbad the sailor. You have been asked for help by the Princess to defeat the Black Prince and his minions from hell. You will fight pirates and genies, find romance and heartbreak, comedy and tragedy.

Sinbad and the Throne of the Falcon is a more action-oriented game than most other Cinemaware releases, though it still contains strategy portions in which the player has to tactically move troops around to secure victory. The game features many arcade and fighting sequences, as well as limited decision-making moments

211497.overview:
In this game we follow the protagonist Francisco Silverman, a newcomer to the beaches of the new world.

Now that you are in the Indies, you are looking for new adventures. Why not look for a treasure? investigate the clues, discover the path, navigate, explore and find a treasure of legend.

Thus begins a game with a bit of arcade, some scavenger hunt, and a lot of adventure. Explore landscapes, cities, mountains, beaches, caves and the ocean in search of a legendary island.

211527.overview:
Amiga port of Mojon Twins 8 bits game.  
 
Sir Ababol is a 2D platform game about Sir Ababol, a young crusader from Manchester City who lives in the 11th century. He witnesses the courage of St. George from Capadocia against the infidels and stumbles over a rock, falling into the Alcoraz River that carries him to the Monegros' Desert. When he wakes up he realizes he has lost his sword. He asks a farmer about the sword and is directed to a land full of ababol flowers. He is confused, but believes the red flowers may be tied to recovering his sword and decides to collect them, hoping to then continue his journey to Jerusalem.

The game consists of a single, large level that comprises many single-screen rooms. The player can explore freely as the rooms are linked horizontally and vertically. To win the game 25 red flowers have to be collected in any order and then the game is won right away. Sir Ababol can move around and jump. He has no means to attack enemies and creatures and has to avoid them. Water is also a hazard. Sometimes keys need to be picked up to open doors to continue to a next section. Sir Ababol has a large amount of health with a single life. He can sustain more than one hundred hits, but life is drained quickly when in water or in an enemy's path. Health also counts down over time, acting as a time limit to complete the game. Some screens contain chicken to restore some health.

The NES and Amiga versions keep the original level lay-out, but with a few changes to the gameplay. The entire level is turned into a side-scrolling environment. Sir Ababol only has nine lives, but he is able to jump on top of enemies to kill them.

211549.overview: Originally scheduled for release in 1993 on the Amiga, this horizontally scrolling space shooter would eventually be reworked and released for PC and MUCH later as a Nintendo Switch game. Here you see it in its infant form. In it waves of aliens are randomly generated so that you cannot develop a pattern of play. You have 4 classes of weapons, with three power levels each to explore.

211574.overview:
Starbase 13 is a sci-fi point & click adventure game for the Amiga, created in AMOS. It uses a LucasArts-style action bar with seven actions: "Walk", "Examine", "Operate", "Use", "Take", "Talk" and "Shoot". "Use" and "Operate" are separate because "Use" always involves two objects as in "Use (...) with (...)", while the "Operate" action always involves one object. There are five save game slots that you can save to using keys F6-F10, and load from with keys F1-F5. Starbase 13's pathfinding algorithm is a little temperamental, and sometimes you may need to manually guide the character around obstacles by clicking several points along the way.

The hero of the game is Yeno Hou, a member of the crew on the Starship 8.3. In the introduction, he is summoned by the captain and given a mission to investigate a space station that has been broadcasting a distress signal.

Unlike in some graphic adventures, it is possible to die in Starbase 13, and some parts require quick reflexes to succeed.

Starbase 13 was followed by a sequel in 1995, titled "Epsilon 9: Revenge of the Stingons".

211580.overview:
The game takes place in a medieval fantasy world, in a little kingdom called Chrisandia, in the south of the Marak peninsula. It is not very densely populated and it makes a living from the fishery and the trading with the northern countries. Its actual king, Orlof VI the doughty, is a member of a long dynasty of kings distinguished themselves during the conquests of the era of ashes. During the wars against the evil emperor Sul Rakin, the kingdom demonstrated a great courage despite the losses. The events in the game take place five years after the fall of the emperor, in the year 351 of the era of crystal.

The Shadows of Sergoth is a dungeon crawler in subjective view for the Commodore Amiga with 2Mb of ram. It is based on the 2018 Amstrad CPC 6128 game by Christophe Petit & Kukulcan.

Team that worked on the project:

-    Ten Chu (graphics)
-    Colin Vella (code)
-    Mike Richmond (music and sound)

Main features of the game:

-    Rules are freely based on Microlite20, which is an extreme simplification of the Advanced Dungeon & Dragons.
-    3 difficulty levels
-    24 spells to learn
-    5 races with different characteristics: human, elf, dwarf, half-Orc and human-lizard
-    Save system
-    Auto-map
-    20 levels to explore
-    HD Installer
-    Level Editor with Scripting Support

211624.overview: An Amiga remake of the classic ZX\C64 game by Alternative Software, create by Mikael Persson in 2014. This is going to be a tough mission for our superhero - SuperTed. His best friend Spotty has been kidnapped by the evil and tricky Texas Pete with his henchmen Bulk and Skeleton. Luckily, Spotty is carrying a homing device which he manages to switch on before being bundled into Texas Pete's car. You must help SuperTed rescue Spotty. Remember SuperTed is no ordinary bear, he has many special powers - not least of all he can fly!

211678.overview:
It is the last day of 1999, and the player visits their aunts house. In a diary the player reads that the devil will take over the world the following day. The player must save the world from within the house.

The game lacks a save feature, despite it being very easy to die. The game's language is only in Slovakian.

211679.overview: Skarb Templariuszy is an adventure game with graphics presented in the form of photographs. The action takes place in an old Castle and in the surrounding countryside. The main goal of the player is finding a mystical ring opening the treasure of the Templar Order Knights. The character may carry up to ten items that can be used and combined. The game screen is divided into inventory/action panel, commentary field and photograph showing the current location.

211702.overview:
The Christmas version of Dodgy Rocks. Dodge the rocks and other projectiles coming your way for as long as possible. Dodge, dash, kick and smash your way out of tight spots to survive just one more wave. Discover and master advanced moves to rack up your bonus and climb the online leaderboards, before testing yourself against the next difficulty level. Are you ready for NIGHTMARE? We don't think you are.

Dodgy Rocks. How dodgy can you get?

211703.overview:
Shoot 'em Baddies is exactly what it says. And that's all you'll have to do to complete the game. It might be offensive if taken seriously but in fact the characters portrayed in this production are wholly fictitious and any resemblance to any person or persons are totally coincidental. That aside, the game will test your reflex skill and mouse control to an extreme you may otherwise never reach. For this reason, you have a selection of difficulties which cater to ages 6 to 60.  
 
Your hosts during this game have created a set from which your finer qualities may, or may not, be extracted. Qualities such as mercy, budgeting and reflex among other physical talents such as observation. Visit the shop to spend earned funds to shoot baddies better, faster and more explosively. DO not shoot civilians. If they do not carry a gun,  you should consider them civilians until proven otherwise. Once you have cleared the area, look to the doors and windows for any other assailants.

211710.overview: An original idea - grow your own bevy of herbivora and protect it against your foe´s carnivores. You can strike him by few catastrophes (storms, vulcans etc.) or grow your own beasts of prey and attack him. You will gain stronger and stronger animals and battles are tougher and tougher.

211725.overview: A skateboarding game originally a Atari ST game. Ported to the Amiga in AMOS.  Things start off fairly easy in level 1, in which you have to grab dollar bills and avoid obstacles as you skate down a highway. In level 2, you're suddenly bombarded with flying debris. Avoid at all costs. Level 3 has you jumping from one part of a highway two another. In level 4, you grind along the rails of a train track. Futuristic cars try to ram you from behind in the mad metropolis of level 5. In level 6, you are equipped with a gun to fight some kind of giant caterpillar. An even larger mutant creature attacks in level 7 and you must survive for set a mount of time. Level 8 is a beach littered with bones and craters on which you have to evade fast-moving tricycles. The final level is a city street littered with turds, mushrooms, skeletons and, weirdly enough, sunbathing citizens.

211735.overview: Yet another game similar to snake. There are hundred levels, passwords, graphics change every fifth level, you can play with different music etc...

211743.overview: The space station Zenith X has just exploded, releasing its cargo: thousands of priceless gems into the cosmos.It is your job to scavenge as many of these gems as possible, but there's a catch. There's always a catch. All the gems are floating inside a huge asteroid storm, which is also inhabited by hostile aliens. It is up to you to fly across 20 different sectors, gathering as many gems as you can. Your commander will update you on how many gems are detected in each sector.

211744.overview: In this sequel to the original you once again find yourself dealing with the explosion at the space station Zenith X, which released its precious cargo: thousands of priceless gems into the cosmos.It is your job to scavenge as many of these gems as possible, but there's a catch. There's always a catch. All the gems are floating inside a huge asteroid storm, which is also inhabited by hostile aliens. It is up to you to fly across 20 different sectors, gathering as many gems as you can. Your commander will update you on how many gems are detected in each sector. This one has Scrolling, bosses, more weapons and stuff.

211746.overview: A platformer game with lite puzzle elements written in AMOS but functions like it was coded in assembler. Super smooth parallax scrolling with animated backgrounds in this platfomer by Bitwise Design and released as shareware in 1992, eventually released to the Public domain by Fraser Ashworth (aka Fray), the creator.

211751.overview: A very great little party game for two at a time. It is addictive and can be used in competition races between more players. In it, you are a pilot who must navigate his ship down a horizontally-scrolling tunnel. Your craft crawls along at first but speed gradually increases until it breakneck pace. As you go, the once roomy tunnel narrows precipitously and branches into even narrower forks. Pick your route as some are far more demanding than others. You have a number of shield points and you lose one every time you make contact with the wall. Simple, hectic,demanding and FUN!

211755.overview:
This is the first part of a graphical adventure game. (We don't have
time enough to finish it).

The interface is very similar to the game "Monkey Island".
Everything in the game is made using the mouse: the first button is used
to select and the second one is used cancel actions or to bypass animations.

You can save just one game clicking with the left mouse button on the
left part of the save/load button. clicking on the right part reload the
game previously saved.

211762.overview: A Scramble-like space shooter game with coding, graphics & music by Tobias Eckert; helicopter drawn by Andreas Dubhorn. Originally sold as shareware, Space Rescue was re-released as freeware in 2017. Similar to the arcade classic Scramble, you pilot a spacecraft and navigate a gigantic cave system. Emphasis here is on memorizing the best route through obstacles and to the next refueling station. Space Rescue is an okay game for its age and can be completed in under 10 minutes if you have already perfected the levels.

211763.overview: A version of Pengo for two simultanous players. Just as in standard Pengo, you must defeat the enemy by pushing ice blocks together to crush them. You also can capture one if they are shocked and dizzy. There is also a time limit to make it a bit more difficult Now Pengo and Willy can join forces to take out the bad guys, so get your acts together!

211773.overview: An unofficial James Pond game which was sold commercially by F1 Licenceware. It is quite good if you can look past inferior graphics, some problems with collision detections, sounds from Magic Pockets, and the lack of ingame music. There are more than 50 levels, an amount which will keep you occupied for quite a while. The difficulty is not too high, even a bit on the easy side.

211777.overview: Szalter is a new puzzle game for the Amiga made by Benedykt Dziubałtowski and Czesław Mnich. In the game you must turn on all the light-bulbs. The light-bulbs switch on or off when you walk by them. The game can be played on a 68k Amiga (diskette or hard disk).

211780.overview: An attractive and fun to play Pac-Man clone...well to say that is unfair. It looks almost nothing like Pac-Man. It has a vibe all its own. However, you do go through a maze picking up dots and fruit, baddies roam the maze and try to get you. You can turn the tables on them... for a time. This one has levers and gates and teleporters and a bunch of other stuff, but in the end it it about getting that last dot off the screen....so Pac-Man with a twist? Pac-Man's other personality? Matthew Goode knows, he made this and gave it to the world in 1993.

211783.overview: The concept is simply an enhanced and improved version of the well known Tetris game.

211793.overview: Samba Partie is a Sports game, developed and published by Sayonara, which was released in Europe in 1996.  There are two sequels: Samba Partie Professional (also released in 1996) and Samba World Cup (1998).

211798.overview:
A role-playing game written in F-BASIC. Game map design by David G. Boelema; additional map design by Brandon Holmes; and game ideas by Scott Millin and Brandon Holmes. Coding by David L. Timmer. Graphics/animation by David A. Huang. Game features savegame support (savegame disk creator is contained on disk 4) and a quit back to WB option. Shelober's Quest for a Babe is a top down perspective RPG game, where the player must help Shelober find all 5 of the parts required for the ultimate mating call burp. The action takes place in a Labor - Land labyrinth. Shelober is described by two character factors (health, strength) and three possession factors (bucks, chunks, keys). He can carry and use various items, read messages, search objects and engage enemies. The fight screen is divided into action part, commentary part and stats part. Shelober may hit the enemy or scream, forcing him to move one step back. Bucks, chunks and keys are required to reach closed parts of the maze and may be used as currency.

The game features 30 levels in total and over 25 types of monsters.

211803.overview: A vertically scrolling shooter by A. Alberto Ruiz of Pyramid Games, released in 1991. Created in AMOS but with very high quality and multiple levels to play.

211812.overview: In 1994, Kaiko GmbH publishes Software Manager on Amiga, a strategy and simulation game. In this game, you run your own software company. Your responsibility is to hire and fire programmers and artists, buy decent concepts, then do your best to get the project done - and finally see if it is better than your competitors' products!

211813.overview:
Super TaeKwonDo Master is a 2D action martial arts simulator for 1 or 2 players (3 to 6 players in tournament mode). Like Mortal Kombat the game uses fully digitized characters, superimposed into a computer generated world in splendid graphical glory. Settings include a combat hall, backstreets and a fuel dump. Sequences of joystick moves are used to trigger special moves.

Unlike Mortal Kombat and the like, the moves are purely realistic. There's no hurling fireballs at your enemy here, you must be a quality fighter to take on these guys. Strategy and skill are of the utmost importance. Unlike the non-'Super' version, this edition runs on non-AGA systems as well as AGA.

Despite being released as an OCS/ECS version only, SUPER TAEKWONDO MASTER is an enhanced update of TAEKWONDO MASTER (AGA) featuring more attractive graphics (albeit using fewer colours), hand-drawn scrolling background graphics with more expansive fighting arenas and more skilled opponents.

211825.overview: Take on the Empire in this 2.5D space shooter set around the battle of Yavin from the A New Hope. Recreates the Death Star battle from the finale of Star Wars: A New Hope. TIE Fighters attack from the front while larger Empire and Rebel battleships pass by in the distance. Looks pretty good for an AMOS game, especially the Death Star trench sequence at the end. If you activate music in the options, you get to hear the Star Wars main theme once but it could use more music.

211827.overview:
Statoscuro is an overhead shoot'em-up game a la Chaos Engine, where you take control of the storm trooper of an evil alien race that plan to
conquer the universe. Thus you, as their state of the art fighter, are sent out with orders to conquer every planet you come across. That includes Planet Imatra, located in the far end of the galaxy where this game begins...

211832.overview: A Czech language puzzle\brain game created by Dusan Jirasek of Gate of Dreams.

211879.overview: A fun little board game based on the Board Game "Fox and Geese". You play as soldiers to trap the beast while the beast tries to eat your soldiers.

211887.overview: Starbuster is an Arkanoid style game for the Commodore Amiga. It was developed by Heyrettin Yildiz and released into the public domain in 1993.

211893.overview: SOUND THE SPACE CADET ** was included on the cover disk of Amiga Action Issue #65. A 2D platformer, collector game. A precursor to Ace The Space-Case. I started laughing the first time I saw the attack animation of the player sprite: It is literally impossible to shoot something that is right in front of you because shots fly out at an 45-degree angle. You have bounce shots off the ceiling, and even then, enemies are only affected by the explosion frame of the animation. Unexploded projectiles which you have just thrown do not hurt them. You will constantly spam the attack button, yet only a fraction of your shots will count. It is one of the most ineffective, frustrating-to-use weapons I have ever seen in a game, and I love it!

211901.overview: Find 40 gold coins and you have finished the game. A very short game. But still not so easy as it looks. Your goal is to navigate a large maze and collect 40 coins. Keys open doors to otherwise inaccessible paths.

211905.overview: Struggle is a Pooyan inspired shooter, developed by Axel Kamphausen and published by Amiga Fun, which was released in Europe in 1991 and is for one or two players. Shoot down the mice with your arrows before they get you.

211908.overview:
Swibble Dibble follows a standard platform puzzle format, putting you in control of an aged wizard. He must guide a ball through 85 levels, but this ball does not start in the same place as him. As well as releasing and directing the ball, you must also grab the door's key.

The levels feature lots of hazards and sections which are initially blocked off - you have to shoot Blox out of your wand to create paths to walk across, and shoot away the removable blocks to create gaps in the right places. You have a limited amount of Blox on each level. Some of the blocks will collapse when you touch them, which can be a help or a hinderance. There are plenty of bonus items to collect, although these often require extra planning to reach.

211960.overview:
Originally created in a week by Graeme Cowie (McGeezer) as a cheer up COVID 2020 gift to Amigans everywhere. Control Santa as you leap from roof to roof and deliver presents down the chimneys. It's also a score-based game, and thus each run will be short. All you have to do is to reach the end of the street and you will have completed the game.


Santa Run is a score based game, if you reach the end of the street you will have completed the game. A nice greeting awaits at the end of the game.
In the Title screen you can push Left for easy mode and Right for hard mode.

Easy mode you will be given 150 gifts to throw into the chimneys and 10 special Elf jumps.
Hard mode you will be given 100 gifts and only 5 special Elf Jumps. In hard mode you get more points for reaching further into the game.

211961.overview: Released exclusively for Amiga Action magazine and based on the 1981 Konami Coin-op, Scramble is actually a very old game. It dates back to an Arcade cabinet by Konami from 1981. There are countless clones for many different computer systems. The gameplay always follows this basic formula: You fly a plane or a space ship through caves or mountainous terrain, destroying missiles, tanks, UFOs and other enemies along your path. To refill your tank, you must bomb fuel depots which appear on the ground.

211962.overview: This PD shooter was created by FEZ Production in 1992 and is the Precursor to Intense: Sector One Reborn.

211963.overview:
Freeware game released on an Amiga Power Cover disk (Issue #37, May 1994). But better play the improved shareware version Push 'n' Shove.

The levels in both this and Push 'n' Shove, are very easy compared to the levels in the original version from 1981/1982. The levels in this one are easy compared to most Sokoban games. This game is not that bad, but it could be better with a relaxing tune. There are no ending screen and the high score table does not let you input your name.

211964.overview: A cheap COMMERCIAL version of Sokoban. There are only 18 levels and game has no title or ending screen. At least this runs smooth with no slowdowns on A500   I recognize the music filched from Double Dragon 3 and the balls from Rock 'n

211965.overview: Pick up all the glowing objects without getting hit by a moving object or by falling into a spike. There are 18 screens you have to complete before the game loops and restarts with the first one. Screen 6, 12 and 18 are bonus rounds with a time limit.

211966.overview: The second game in the series, obviously. Another day another journey… As living on planet earth and its surrounding solar system seemed boring Sqrxz decided to check out another location in the universe. Just in case and to be extra careful he took a pocketful of emeralds with him to keep him in ready cash, but after starting his exciting journey he realised all his emeralds are suddenly missing! Retracing his steps Sqrxz notices mysterious creatures popping up all over the place to hinder him in his search… Oh what troublesome days… Help poor Sqrxz get back all his emeralds!

211968.overview:
Reverse engineered from the Atari ST version.  
 
Solomon's Key is a platform game with both action and strategy elements. On each level your goal is to retrieve a key which can then be used to unlock the exit. To help out, you have a magic wand which can be used to create and destroy blocks (though some blocks can't be destroyed). In order to reach the key you will need carefully to arrange the blocks on the screen so you can jump your way around safely. Wandering around each level are a variety of enemies which will cause you to lose a life if you're caught. Some creatures can be killed by destroying the block they are standing on, others must be dodged. Hidden bonuses and magic can be found on many of the levels, sometimes even hidden in blocks. Some treasures give you bonus points, others can form magic spells to help deal with the enemies. To make the game more difficult, each level has a time limit in which it must be completed.

211969.overview: The main Goal of Super Wormy is to gain a high enough score while controlling a snake like creature, moving around a square screen area collecting items while also avoiding your tail or other obstacles as it grows ever larger with each bite.

211970.overview: Q*Bert clone with cute character designs and smooth gameplay. Similar to the original, if a bit more complex especially in later levels. It allows 2 simultaneous gamer play.

212006.overview: Dive to gather precious gems and treasure from off the ocean floor, but avoid the ever present sharks and electric eels.

212017.overview: Another nice 3D Construction Kit creation. A 3D first person RPG adventure game created by C. Millin and released as PD/Freeware.

212018.overview: A simple Battlements/Hunchback game created with AMOS by Andreas Andreou in 1991.

212025.overview: This game, as with the later Shades of Doom allows the player to navigate and fight a path through an enemy-filled maze as one might in a FPS... except solely through the use of directional audio cues to determine the relative location of obstacles and hazards.

212031.overview: The Amiga has several games creators, including Red Pill, Gamesmith, Backbone and Reality. This was made with Reality, and comes as a free editable set of files on a bonus disk with that software. The game was then shipped to CU Amiga as a full game, to demonstrate and advertise Reality. Its smooth and colourful, and not a bad freeware effort, although nothing special.

212032.overview: Quite funny game with a decent graphics. The main task is to collect a letter and the given ammount of stamps and deliver it to the mailbox in time. Also avoid baddied and bad items that consume your energy.Only 6 levels so savor them!

212033.overview: A top down shooter, a second unofficial tribute to the grooviest of arcade genocidal blasters, Smash TV: the Rip-Off is the better of the tributes made, better than Smash Telly that is and in some ways an improvement on the original. It's faster, slicker, easier to control and much much closer to the spirit of the original game. Gloriously psychopathic action from start to finish. Unfortunately way too short.

212034.overview:
Springtime is here, but it‘s certainly not for Hitler and Germany. Your mission: control a little geezer, viewed top-down, over a multi-roatating checkerboard-patterned play area. Each part of the board is hinged in a manner that allows it to be rotated over all the three geometrical axes, x, y, and z.

The aim is to twist the board so that you can line up a spring with a cross. It sounds simple, but thinking in three dimensions can be taxing until you get used to it, and to compound the matter a timer counts down from 99 to zero. If you don’t finish in time, you lose a life.

And then, just as competence seems to be taking hold, the game springs more taxing puzzles on you. For example, some tiles can only be walked on once and, if said tile is to rotate the set-up another way, the restart option has to be triggered. This resets the board to the original position, but doesn’t reset the clock. So truly frantic to-ing and fro-ing takes place.

Fiendishly, as further progress is made, sliding tiles come into play. Apoplexy and involuntary alopecia (look it up) can result, even when the Help option is used to hint at the first few moves you should make.

Springtime is tremendous fun and a game that every puzzle addict should have in their collection.

212035.overview: Operation mouse? This 2D single screen, single player cross-hairs shooter was coded by Dennis van Koningsbruggen of Dimensions and released in 1994. Shot the dropping ammo and power-ups to take out all the trigger-happy rodents.

212036.overview:
An Egyptian themed game by Matt West of aiXS Software also released as part of the CD32 Games pack. Imagine a sun surrounded by 8 planets. You can rotate them around in their orbits using your controller. Each planet is represented by one of the 8 icons or glyphs. The glyph of a planet is cycled by shoot a star at it. The glyphs are, in cycle order. Hand, Kids, Cat, Dog, Star, Rabbit, UFO, EMU. As all this is going on the sun is sinking, once it sets the game is over. In the top right is the target glyph, when you hit a planet with the same glyph as the target the following occurs: If all the planets are the target you've got a match and the sun rises to its original height. If only some are the target the sun rises a bit for each one that matches. All the planets with the target glyph are now replaced with new random glyphs. So your objective is to get as many matches as you can, while getting a high score while trying to stop the sun from setting. Easy as pi.  
 
EXCEPT! The planets attack the sun and drag it down. Shooting them repels them and changes the glyphs. Every 8k points the speed of the planets increases.

212037.overview: Superballz from David Reed is a nice Marble Madness clone with a level editor. It's a remake/parody of the SAT1 Superball TV game. To complete the level, activate all switches to open the exit and then reach the exit.

212050.overview: Can you win the world cup? The ultimate world cup simulation! Play the World Cup, full match arcade section. Every side human or computer controlled. All the thrills of world soccer competition. Extra time and penalty shoot-outs. All results shown in detail. The most versatile & comprehensive game of it's kind. Up to 24 players can take part in a single competition. 100 international teams, including all the current teams competing in the 1994 World Cup. Full editing facility. 2200 international players. Varying weather conditions and pitch type.

212095.overview: A top scrolling shoot em up by MADAXE, and features music by FRED. In this game you play as the yellow ship at the bottom of the screen and must make your way through the level blasting away enemies, collecting power ups, and destroying the boss at the end to continue on to an ever harder level. And that's pretty much it, as if you're expecting a very high quality in your face shoot em up you'll be disappointed, as although there's background graphics and a cool soundtrack.

212096.overview: Another Sokoban style puzzler written in AMOS Professional. Coding by Luděk Roleček. Graphics by Tomáš Celizna. Music by Mário Závodník. Text in the title menu is in Czech, but the game is in Englsigh. Much later published in in Amiga Future no. 123, Nov/Dec 2016

212097.overview:
You play as Smurfette (The female Smurf) and your mission is to save all Smurfs from the evil wizard Gargamel. He have placed all your friends in cages.

You must save them all to complete the levels. When you have saved them, the game will load next level. On the boss levels you also must kill them to complete the levels.

Some Smurfs may look impossible to reach. But they are not :)
All enemies can be killed by jumping on them. Fire is not used for anything in the game.

212098.overview: A snake\worm game that seems to be using two sounds from Anders Bjerin's freeware game SYS (1989): the smacking of lips whenever you eat a white mushroom and the "Yehaa!" when you pick up bonus mushrooms. While the smacking of lips is always sped-up, the "Yehaa!" is either sped-up or slowed-down, depending on what bonus you pick up. It was created by Peter Harris with these assets and released to public domain in 1993.

212099.overview: Blast weird generic aliens that look like potatoes in this odd little shooter for the Amiga. The game was developed by John Schultz and published by Haitex Resources in 1988.

212100.overview: Speedrunner is an platform game, developed by Fantastic Trio and published by Kunert Soft, which was released in Europe in 1989. It is essentially a Lode Runner clone and also has a level editor. 20 levels of a well-made jump & run clone, which includes 200 levels in the commercial version.

212101.overview:
Starbyte Super Soccer is a managerial soccer simulation in which the player takes the role of a soccer manager, responsible both for athletic and financial aspects. The goal of the game is to bring the chosen team from the fourth into the first German soccer league; the game is won when a certain goal (chosen before the game starts) is reached. Besides the German league of the season 1991/1992 (with 18 instead of the real 20 teams) there are also a few fictional scenarios available, e.g. one in which first and return match are directly behind each other or a world league with national teams.

During the game, the player has the usual options to choose from, e.g. lineup, tactics, training camps, transfer market, expanding the stadium or merchandising. The strength of an athlete is calculated from the factors position (how well he can play on the position he has to play), shape (if and how well he played in the past) and energy (physical shape). After each season, the manager has to have a certain amount of money on the club's account (how much depends on the chosen difficulty level) in order to avoid being fired. The game also rates the manager's performance, which is mostly interesting when multiple players are participating. Controls are completely menu based.

212102.overview: Up to four players compete on the Stock Market to make their fortune, by investing in a portfolio of stocks. There are oil companies, car companies and airlines, all with graphs of performance to predict trends from. Bear in mind economic trends as they unfold. You can take out a loan of up to $5m, which must be paid back with interest later. Instructions are largely built into the game, in a way rarely used before the CD-ROM era.

212103.overview: A scrolling platform game created by Light of Betrayal in 1994. In it you play the titular man, jumping over teddies, marking iceblocks touched and grabbing bonus blocks. There are 9 original levels after which it restarts at 1.

212104.overview: Świąteczna awaria is an arcade platform game for up to three players. Mischievous penguin has stolen Santa's sleigh with gifts moments before Christmas. To save Christmas the player must collect the designated number of yellow packages, avoiding penguins, birds, wastebaskets, computers and other hostile creatures. In addition to jumping ability each of the three main characters (Santa, snowman, bear) has a unique temporarily stunning weapon (star, snow ball, colorful ball) and may use numerous power ups (long jumping, extra weapon, shield, fast running, temporary paralysis of all opponents). Occasionally defeated enemy pops up a green package. Gathering it moves to one of two timed mini-games: find two same pictures and find one designated picture. Passing a mini-game is rewarded with an extra life. Originally released as a coverdisk\covermount for Amiga Computer Studio 2/98 in Poland. It was eventually released worldwide in 2008.

212105.overview: Świdroń is a Boulder Dash variant. As a miner the player must collect the designated number of diamonds in an abandoned mine and reach the exit doors before the time runs out. The task is made difficult by falling rocks and growing magma. The equipment includes cement bags and explosives. Cement surrounds the place where the miner stood, and the bomb will blow up the nearest surrounding fields, therefore you should leave the place very quickly. Rocks may be pushed on the drilled field and will fall on such field if it rise underneath. Walking through already drilled tunnels is much faster. To change magma into diamonds Świrdoń need to block it from each side.

212153.overview: Imagine Zaxxon had much improved graphics and full ship control, even to go backwards. Make the enemies more plentiful and the arrays of weapons used against you more varied and you have Straf from Steve Hughes and released in 1990.

212157.overview: A defender inspired game for one, created by Marcel Wolter an published on the Amiga Special as a cover disk.

212158.overview: A short platformer that tests a bit of the latest version of the Scorpion Engine, created by Erik Hogan. This game originally released for the PC by Sergio Cornaga, is an extremely short but varied platform adventure in which you must traverse ever deeper into the ground while also avoiding dangerous enemies

212186.overview: SPACE CAB was available via mail-order only from Tronic Verlag, the publisher of ASM Magazine (Aktueller Software Markt). The game was submitted to Tronic Verlag as part of their "Microwelle Competition", who sought to find a publisher for the game or, failing that, publish the game themselves.

212288.overview: This was originally to be a subgame in a giant, epic space-adventure that the author, SawnBringer worked on for 4 years but never completed, so this was released in a standalone fashion It is a Tennis/Arkanoid/SpeedBall cross, coded in AMOS. You play the tournament for 4 rounds and the opponents get harder each game, with the final tennis boss being very difficult.

212289.overview: You are in command of a Galaxy Class starship. Diplomatic negotiations have broken down due to recent attacks by the Borg, Romulans and the Dominion\Cardassians. Because of this, much of federation space is now undefended and vulnerable to attacks by hostile enemies. Captain, the odds are against us and the situation is grim. Good luck!

212457.overview: An unauthorized conversion of Son of Blagger 1983 Alligata Software for the c64. It even appeared on some PD compilations as Son of Blagger. This version was created by Markus Gunnarsson with music by Daniel Falk. Players control Slippery Sid, who is an espionage agent and son of Blagger. Like the first game, the task is to collect a series of keys scattered around the level. Sid must navigate a series of platforms while jumping over robots that guard the keys. Once Sid collects all the keys, he can make his way to the next level by going through a doorway. Like his father, Sid has a limited time to perform this task, and he loses one of his lives if he fails to collect all of them, or if he falls long distances.

212534.overview:
This is a conversion of the 1981 TSR boardgame "Saga: Age of Heroes", for up to 6 players.

Players can be controlled by human or Amiga. It was written by James Jacobs of Amigan Software.

In Saga: Age of Heroes, players defeat evil monsters, win fabulous treasures and rule great kingdoms in their quest to gain glory and be the one hero whose memory will live on forever in the songs and stories of the age.

The supported languages are currently English, German, Greek and Italian. Source code is included. Note that this version will not work properly on MorphOS. There is a native MorphOS version available.

212535.overview:
A game set in the 16th century Japan a land so torn my civil disorder that the Emperor and the military dictator, the Shogun, were left powerless. In their place rose many independent kingdoms, ruled by the local baron or Daimyo. Daimyo were warriors first and foremost and spent decades fighting each other. You now have the opportunity to be either the En(Circles) Daimyo ro the Daiyamondo(Diamond) Daimyo. Each has five cities on the island of Honshu and both have a desire to rule all ten.  
 
Samurai: The Way of the Warrior is a strategy title in which the player must conquer their opponents' cities on the Island of Honshu in 16th century Japan. The ten cities must be occupied to win, which can be done by forming armies to defend their five cities and attack those of the opponents. When a city is taken, any mobile army that came from that city is automatically disbanded. In this way, potentially overwhelming forces can be routed by conquering their cities -- but only if the player can conquer the city before its army reaches its target. Depending on how the cities are located at the start of the game, players may find this to be a key part of their campaign strategy. When armies battle, the game switches from the strategic map to a tactical one. Formations, unit orders, and morale are factors in the tactical battles.

212536.overview: A 2019 Christmas gift to the Amiga Community. A game created by Johnny Acevedo of Amiten. A mini-game created for teaching purposes with source code included. It was created for the Amos Course of Amiten Labs 2019. Santa Claus need to collect gift boxes for all children´s all over the world and need to escape to evil skulls.If you survive up to 14 skulls , your mission will be completed! Special power up´s, will help you during the game. Speedy,Bombs,Extra Life,Gems. You start the game with 3 lives.

212537.overview:
A top down, two player game of snooker with a very adult theme. Created by Jonathan Harris (who also delveoped Friday Night Pool) and released in 1995.

According to the manual, coder Jonathan Harris for reasons of pragmatism opted to implement an abridged version of snooker (i.e. players start with only 10 red balls on the table instead of the usual 15) in SATURDAY NIGHT SNOOKER. He felt that it would make for shorter, more entertaining games of snooker and that the software title itself would otherwise benefit from enhanced graphics & animation.

212538.overview: Shoot your friend's flying saucer. A 2 player, top\bottom split screen dueling game where each player controls a little flying saucer created by Robert Kihl and Martin Gunnarsson of Snarl-up Software n 1997. Pick up weapons and upgrades along the way.

212539.overview:
During the warm summer nights of 1994-95 TYN, BCO and JEFF create the first two games of 4 Seasons software: "Savoiardo, the videogame" and "Top Tilers".  Savoiardo is a puzzle game, it was conceived by TYN, among thousand unfinished projects, and is the first completed game from the 4 Seasons Team. The game was made to "pay homage" to a weird character born from JEFF's imagination. The SAVOIARDO (a famous brand name in Italy) is a tall and very strong biscuit-man who have the power to absorb anything. Actually, the SAVOIARDO it's only the testimonial of the game.In order to win the game, you'll have to pile up figurines with the purpose of reproducing exactly the composition on the right of the screen.

Here's how it works. The game will give you a figurine. You can discard it or let it drop into a column. If you put a figurine in the wrong place, the column will be erased and you'll have to rebuild the column again.When you place correctly all the figurines in order to reproduce the exact composition, you win the game.

The game has 10 level, each with different compositions and accompanied by a pleasant music made by TYN.

212540.overview: A German language strategy game for 1-4 players, however knowledge of German is only necessary for the instructions and for a few screen-texts. According to the author's text document it is a cross between Battleforce and BattleIsle and has been written in AMOS (The Creator) by Peter Weigoldt. Multiple updates for this game came out with version 2.15 coming out in 2000 and a conversion to C from AMOS in 2004.

212550.overview: An AMOS PD game released on the Assassins Disk 252. This is a cartoon style puzzle game in which you must guide Schnebitz through each puzzle by moving certain colored blocks into their correct positions.

212551.overview: A 2D wargame submarine simulation game created by Bauer and available on Fred Fish 462.

212553.overview: Seemore Doolittle's Toyland Capers was created in a week using the Reality software construction package, this candyland\Christmas themed shooter was made by B Bell and released as an Amiga Format coverdisk 87b. In it, waves of teddy bears, toffees candies and sweets seek to pummel you from both sides of the screen while you shoot and avoid them as long as you can. Every destroyed baddie releases cake which you try to pick up before they fall off the screen to upgrade your weapons.

212554.overview:
7Realms Full Game! Action RPG in Blitz 2.1.  The game involves traveling around the game world, entering cities, and talking to the inhabitants, to find out information about your quest. On your way around, you will have to fight the evil enemies which have taken up residence in your home realm.

   The concept of the game was to write a simple RPG. There are no thousands of useless objects, and no complex fight system. The aim was to create a
simple RPG which people other than experienced RPG fans could enjoy. This, the full version of the game, has been released as public domain on
the first anniversary of the date of its completion.

212555.overview: Your aim is to color dirty walls within one color only. To change a color you must catch one of the bouncing balls on it, but there are also hunting skulls to make your job harder by the way.

212556.overview: SHAPES is a puzzle game contained on Assassins Disk 051 PD compilation, written by Mike Archer and released in 1991. Fill the space given with shapes provided, much more difficult than it looks.

212557.overview: A puzzle game written in AMOS from swe. NC.Gamez where you have a row of blocks in the top left corner of the screen. Select one of them and past it anywhere possible on the screen. It may be rotated with your right mouse button. The idea is to fill the empty parts of the area and then you will be led to the next level.

212558.overview: Sheep are flying through the air in different arcs and speeds. Your job in this cross-hairs shooter created by Greg Sikorski in 1996 is to blast them out of the air before they reach the ground. Ewe wool need to be fast to be the baaahdest shot and make the hi-score list.

212559.overview: 40 levels of puzzle fun, with level passwords to start right where you left off. Created by Peter Annuss in 1996. Match 2 or more colors side by side to have them removed, careful NOT to leave an odd single of that color out at the end!

212561.overview: The Shining Way of Kung Fu is a versus fighting game. Every match is a single, non time-limited round which ends once either fighter's energy bar is depleted. A standard set of punches, kicks and sweeps is available to all the fighters. There is a choice between four fighters, though that does not affect the set of moves. Single matches can be played in 2-player versus mode.

212562.overview:
Shisen-Sho is an Amiga adaptation of the mahjong game for both English and German speaking players, though not much is needed either way. The player must remove all tiles from the board by pairing matching tiles up; only visible tiles whose longer side is completely unobstructed can be removed. Only two matching tiles may be removed at a time, and they can only be removed if they are connected by a horizontal or vertical path via empty or vacant spaces. If no moves are available and tiles are left on the board, the game is lost.

Shisen-Sho uses custom tiles by the game's developer Franz "Zebulon" Janisch of the Stylon Crew, rather than the traditional set and additional rules were added to spice things up a bit including multiplier stones, stones farther from each other give more points. Helps can blast away stones but you will score better if you do not use them.

212563.overview: Shoot Out 2 is an updated version of my previous games with the same name. A PC version is also in development. It's kind of a game of cat and mouse where you have to blow up your opponent's ship while trying to avoid his shots!

212564.overview:
This is an improved version of Shoot Out 2 (so2.lha) and was featured in Amiga Format issue 135, where it received a pretty good review and reception. The one player game is fast and furious, though perhaps a bit too easy without a human opponent, which is still available! No matter, it’s still a very definite improvement. Another addition is that you can now enter different sectors; instead of simply playing up and down one side of the screen, your ship can go all the way around the screen by entering the sector gates at the corners of the screen as you press the fire button. This can be a fun way of infuriating your opponent, especially because you can both be in the same sector at the same time, which makes it impossible to shoot 
or be shot at. There are also new weapon power ups in this version such as plasma and double shot.

212565.overview: Shoot-Out from Frank Otto has a deceiving title as you are involved in no shooting.  Your objective is to collect gems on the level and avoid the bullets from the enemies patrolling the edges of the level and any skulls mixed in with the gems.

212566.overview:
Released in a full commercial version and a PD Demo version that does not include the ability to use the computer player. A game of backgammon, where the pieces are "mushies" and you need to get them all across the board based on your random die rolls. Follows standard backgammon rules. Pieces on the bank must be moved before other pieces can proceed. If you can go, you must go unless there is no legal move. The game is over when one player removes all their pieces from the field. BackGammon points awarded if the other player still has pieces on his half of the board, Gammon awarded if no pieces in the back section, but no pieces yet removed and a simple win if you were both in process of removing pieces.   
 
Optional rules can be set to limit stacking to 5 pieces. Change how rolling 2 of the same die are handled and so forth.

212567.overview: Amiga Pong for AGA with some nice graphic backgrounds and some trippy random blockers for one or 2 players created by James "Jamux" Hall in 1994.

212568.overview:
The year is 2076 and the world is ruled by evil aliens...however there are still rebels and you are one of them. All plans are made in a secret hideout which one day gets found by the police. You know that they will be there soon, but there is just one chance of escape. As you look at that chance you smile...it is a very old ship called: Silverblade.  
 
A PD shooter by Mirrorman, released in 1992.

212569.overview:
Skimmers 0.870 is a demo racing game by Gareth Williams of Team Mango with 2 different racing craft and 4 arenas. Set in the year 2030, civilization as we know it has been downtrodden by wars and violent outbursts of cosmic storms. The Earth has been destroyed as a result of man's negligence. The few hundred that have escaped have formed small colonies on whatever they could find floating around in the infinite void of space.  
 
On a small red planet dwell four violent gangs of boy racers that want to fight for territory on their small planet. You must step into the shoes of the leader of one of these four gangs and become the ruler of the planet by conquering the other gangs. The planet is represented by a map of 7x7 squares. To take a territory, the gangs race against each other. The race is won not just by who is first, but by who has the most blood points awarded for each lap. Points eared by completing laps and for damaging opponent's Skimmer craft.

212570.overview: A single screen dogfight game by Dave and Den released in 1997. It is a game for up to 8 human or computer controlled players. It is based on the classic game, Dogfight, which involves killing the other players by shooting down their planes to win and can be played in league mode.

212571.overview: A game of the Amiga Games Pack created by Luca Carminati of his Amiga games created from 1993 to 1998. This skiing game was originally created in 1993 with revisions in 1995 and 1997. In it you ski around the flags on the way to the finish line and try to get the best time possible, with penalties for missed flags, it supports up to 8 players.

212576.overview: Guide the skier through a series of flags and to the finish line, a game created by Jayenkai and released on December 25, 1997.

212578.overview: A German language puzzle game for one player, Game idea by Christian Günther and Joachim Mertens. Coding in GfA Basic by Joachim Mertens. Graphics by Christian Günther and level design by Sascha Lehner and released in 1993.

212579.overview: You have been sent to clean up. Hoover up the growing slime before it covers everything! When you fill your tank you must empty it, which takes some time, meanwhile the slime grows and multiplies and your time is running out! A homebrew game by Fay Latham, written in AMOS and released in 1993.

212585.overview: A Non-AGA conversion of Klondike deluxe for all Amiga owners to use that retains the ability to load and use other card graphics sets. It uses all the standard rules of Klondike solitaire. There are many additional card sets that can be downloaded. Some currently out are based around Star Trek, Star Wars, reptiles, heroines, faces, famous art, anime, mammals, dragons, Achilleos and even adult themes of various kinds. While the card sets are required to be available to the public domain, not all card sets contain only public domain images.

212589.overview: A basic horizontal shooter written in AMOS by Alessandro Russo aka Axel. A simple but charmy space-game inspired by famous games like Nemesis, Gradius and ProjectX. Many sites have this game being initially released in 2014, but the first release appears to have been in 1992.

212590.overview: A simple German language stone-PUSHing game in the style of Sokoban made by Silvio Lange of Diamondsoft. Push the stones to the X spots, using teleporters to avoid trouble spots and don't forget that there is a time limit.

212594.overview: A shareware sports management game written by Michael Keith Lysons where version 1.3 was released in 1993. Develop your team and then pit them against other teams. The games are displayed with generated commentary on how the game progressed based on how well you developed your teams. Coach and transfer players between teams. Play matches and go for The Cup!

212595.overview: A timed puzzle game by Tranquilizer of Secretly aka Mike Delling with a passcode feature to return quickly to levels. Slide the pieces around and match the colors to remove them from the field.

212597.overview: Slider is a picture puzzle game created by Joseph Carlson and released in 1996. A high res picture is shuffled and you must slide pieces in order to recreate the original picture in as little time as possible.

212598.overview: A German language turn based, top-down, strategy war game created by Rainer Mosner that comes with a scenario editor and was released by Gamebench, a Markt & Technik company.

212600.overview: A fast driving game where you blast through the countryside, splashing through rivers and puddles and jumping ditches and lava flows on 3 courses. Careen through puddles to extinguish any on board fires the lava may have caused. Press fire and pull back to get the most out of the jumps. Avoid pedestrians and hit the ramps when possible to jump ditches. Each course does seem to come with a mid-level boss where you can shoot the scarecrow heads you avoided in previous parts of the game at the boss. Some of what you need to do to be most successful is intended as a puzzle to be figured out according to the creator,  J. Richard Evans who released this game to the public domain in 1992. The game and color palette heavily inspired by old Spectrum games.If you want more info just read the German or English versions of the readme.

212602.overview:
A public domain Star Trek battle simulator. The intrepid search continues to boldly go where no Amigan has gone before. Or something like that anyway. In SoloTrek 2, your objective is to map out the entire galaxy, dealing accordingly with any Romulan, Klingon or Federation ships you 
encounter along the way. It’s an incredibly complex and involving game which is going to demand a good deal of time and effort from anyone seeking to really get to grips with it. If you persevere though, in the long run, it’s the sort of game which could prove infinitely more rewarding than a straightforward shoot-em-up. 

There are a whole host of gadgets to be clicked on as you navigate your way around the galaxy. In true Trek style there are five main systems on board your ship (shields, impulse engines, warp drive, phasers and photon torpedoes) between which power can be allocated, so if you’re a true Trekkie you will be able to blurt out such cliches as “Warp factor ten, Scotty” with alarming regularity.

212603.overview: Was released as a Amiga Format cover disk, In this game by Kelvin Truswell you must avoid alien entanglements as you collect up all the cans in different sectors of space. You more you collect the higher your score, but each sector has a challenge all its own.

212604.overview: Roll around the level, blast the blobby blue aliens and grab the goodies. Throw the levers where necessary and make your way to the flag to get to the next level in this game coded in Blitz Basic.  An isometric shooter that was sent in to the Amiga Format Blitz Basic competition. Created by Peter and Kallie K.

212605.overview: Space Combat is a project in REDPILL without much pretension. The only goal of the game is to get more points than your friends. Originally released for CAPACITOR PARTY 2017. A top down space shooter with the possibility of playing against each other in a two player mode.

212606.overview: If you remember Space Invaders you'll probably know what to expect in this game, with enemy waves moving in a particular pattern which need to be defeated before they reach your ship. In this case the aliens are green groovie ghoulie ghosties or technicolor musrooms or giant glowing heads and each new level has a great multi-color game name splash. This one was never released in 1992, but was released to the scene with source code intact in 2017.

212607.overview: A homebrew shooter game, written in AMOS by Antonio Ruiz Fernández & José María Ruiz Moreno of Pyramid Entertainment and released in 1993. It is the typical multiplayer game, with simple graphics and up to 4 players where you had to exterminate the opponent. Very funny with other players but can be played alone against computer controlled ships.

212608.overview: A licenseware game created by Paul Overy and released in 1992. This 2 player space shooter with a basic design that harkens back to Asteroids. This game features controllable missiles and protection shields

212609.overview: The idea of Spectra is to change the coloured circles on the left of the screen to match those on the right of the screen. Simple as that...or is it? You begin with 3 lives and each level has a strict time limit. When you click on the left mouse button on a circle it changes the colour of the circle you click on through two colours in a range, and all adjacent circles move on just one colour in the range. The range of the colours are: Red, Green, Blue, Magenta, Yellow. The faster you complete the level, the greater the number of points you will recieve.

212610.overview: A remake of the famous early platform game that hit the arcades in 1980, this 1990 remake by T. Wittwer for the Amiga sticks to the same script. You play an astronaut with limited oxygen (time) chased around by various space aliens. Your only method of dealing with these multicolored threats from space is to dig a hole, lure it into a hole, and then manually fill up the hole with the alien in it. Dropping aliens on top of other aliens earns you extra points and eliminates both. Levels get progressively harder and enemies grow faster.

212611.overview: At 1996 dueling shooter game by Buny and Duffy of NCD Forèveur for tournament party play. In the first part of the game players determine how many of the shields in front of them to eliminate, then the duel phase begins where each tries to take the other out.

212612.overview: A sequel to HydroZone created by David J. Cruickshank of Skull Army and released in 1996. The game supports up to 6 players in a split screen mode. The game comes complete with a level editor. Coded with Blitz Basic II 1.7 and Graphics done with Deluxe Paint 4.

212613.overview: A German language freeware game created by "Roy Schneider" and released in 1994. Set in deep space in a time of great spaceships and computer controlled robots. You are part of a crew that salvages old ships and find something strange and send in a little probe to go through the labyrinthine hulk and you must scan it all, find the diskettes that give info on the cargo and batteries to keep yourself powered up. Watch out for traps and danger. Some white boxes need energy and will drain yours if you touch them. There is also a time limit per area so work quickly.

212614.overview:
It's a Destruction Derby in 2D RGB that sparkles. Initially, you will have to choose the number of players from six offered. For each of them, you can determine if it will be played by the computer or by a human, in which case you will choose the control mode (gamepad 1, gamepad 2, keyboard...). Hey there, let's go! You will soon find yourself in RGB circuits. Each game is played in six rounds by default (so six playing areas), where the goal is to stay last on the track: you can settle from one to twenty rounds.

The principle consists of colliding with the other competitors to make them suffer damage and get them out of the playing area. When a vehicle explodes for example, the flickering of the screen is intense and may not be suitable for gamers with sensitivity to flashing lights.

212618.overview: A 2 player single screen space duel created in 1990 by Lane Waters for Odyssey Software. You can choose your ships and the space sector the battle will take place in and then you must use the weapons systems you've picked to your best advantage. Shorts bursts of shield protect you for a second or two, but as always, keep moving to make yourself a more difficult target.
