448176.overview: A SEUCK based shooter by Jason Redway released as part of the SEUCK Vault in association with Binary Legends. In this vertically scrolling shooter you fly over lad defenses, blasting and shooting both the flying foes and taking out ground defenses.

448181.overview: Intended to be a full Commercial release, the full game remained unfinished and it, along with a freeware version were released by Source X in 1992.

448185.overview: An AMOS mini-game created by Tony Kingsmill and released as freeware in February of 1991.

448490.overview: Step into the monochromatic and mind-bending universe of Shift, where black and white landscapes hide more than meets the eye...where inside is outside, and light and dark don't differ!

449307.overview: An educational, single player version of Thrust\Gravitar that helps teach math. You thrust in different directions by answering the corresponding math question.

449432.overview:
This computer coloring book is another part in the Electric Crayon series and it has 30 pictures featuring 1-10 numbers. Each picture includes the number of certain items, this number as digit written in some way and this number written as word (for example, three rabbits in the three magic hats or ten bones for a dog) with famous characters from Sesame Street to color.

Pictures could be colored from a palette of 16 colors. A mix button would "mix" the current color with the 15 other colors and give a total of 256 colors. Choosing a color and clicking in the picture do a color fill in the area clicked. The finished, or in progress, coloring was automatically saved to disk. Player may also remove all colors applied previously to start coloring from the very beginning.

Pictures could be printed with or without a monthly calendar, description, or message.

In Amiga version pictures could be colored from a palette of 24 colors and with mix gives a total of 576 colors. Voices are also present in this version.

449686.overview: An education with sand between your toes! Enjoy Simon Says at the Beach, Alphabet Scramble, Let's Go Fishing, LitterBugs, the Rock Pool, Spelling Fun and other fun and adventuresome games! The game was developed and published by Rush, which was released in Australia in 1993.

449690.overview: A single player educational game with games like Simon Says, On the Farm, Junior Publisher, Animal Guess, Teach George and Farm Fun! Created by Rush Software in 1992.

449691.overview: An educational game that is fun and teaches you about Australia! Play Simon Says Around Australia, Astraliana Memory, Where is Australia, Jigsaw Jumble and Find-A-Word.

450002.overview: A cooperative space shooter for 1-2 players developed by Michael Pratt using the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit, and published in 1990 by Berliner Spielekiste.

450015.overview: A one or two player blobberific racing game of the joystick-killer variety. Move your joystick back and forth as quickly as you can and make your blob's way across the finish line first.

450024.overview:
A vertically scrolling shooter that masquerades as a climber and superhero game, in which you play as a character that somewhat resembles a certain Marvel Comics web slinger.

The game was developed by Ray Larsbie using the Shoot 'em Up Construction Kit, and released in 1991.

450274.overview: SkyBlitz 2 is a Blitz/Bomber clone developed by Tom & Kev and released into the public domain in 1991.

450277.overview: Spinvaders is a Space Invaders variant developed by Brian Hills and released into the public domain in 1993.

450331.overview: Super 2.0 is a side-scrolling shooter for the Amiga. It was developed by Michele Berionne and released into the public domain in 1994.

451600.overview:
Four "Superheroes" games in one compilation pack:

◉    Last Ninja 2
◉   Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
◉    Strider 2
◉    James Bond: The Spy Who Loved Me

451603.overview:
The Story So Far: Vol 3 is a collection of four Amiga games released in 1989.

    Bomb Jack
    Live and Let Die
    Thundercats
    Space Harrier

451759.overview: A game very much like a 15 slider puzzle, except you are recreating the dumbell parts into a coherent picture. A puzzle game by David Cole in 1989, published by Wicked Software as Shuff-It.

452404.overview: A 1-2 player cooperative space shooter developed by Michael Pratt and published by Berliner Spielekiste in 1990.

452413.overview: Super Tomcat is a 1-2 co-operative shooter developed by Donald Lindsay and Mark Waudby via the Shoot 'Em Up Destruction Kit. It was released into the public domain in 1992.

452419.overview: A German language, 2 player Super Sprint clone released as shareware in 1993 by MS Software and published by Nordlicht Spiele. The game has 10 levels that you'll only see if you or your opponent don't destroy your vehicles. You can drop mines or leave oil slicks on the track too.

452422.overview: Clone of the 1980 arcade game of the same name. Developed by Hartmut Westphal.

452471.overview: Stealth Master is a Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit game developed by Stew Perkins and released into the public domain in 1992.

452472.overview: Stench: The Invasion of the Bogs is a 1-2 player co-operative shooter made using the Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit by VSC Productions. It was released in 1995.

454312.overview:
Electric Black Sheep proudly presents Star Dust Wars, a fan-made homage to the legendary Star Wars arcade game that captured the imagination of players worldwide back in 1987-88. This space shooter reimagines the beloved original in what we believe is a more visually stunning environment, combining nostalgic gameplay with modern creative touches. Created purely for the love of the classic and not for profit, Star Dust Wars offers a unique experience with custom-designed graphics and animations. While the sounds may echo familiar tones from a galaxy far, far away, the music – including Star Wars-inspired tracks by Humanoids Media and thrilling War Drum beats by Amaksi originates from freely available sources, adding an epic backdrop to the action.
Dive into Star Dust Wars and relive the magic of the arcade era, redefined for today.
Released on November 30, 2024, this tribute celebrates the enduring legacy of a universe that defined a generation.

Technical:
We don't think that when AMOS was developed, they would have thought that we would use it to implement something like this. A simple FMV game that requires resources, but don't let anyone think it's magic. It's rare to see a similar game on the Amiga, so we thought it was worth a try.

The game is for AMIGA only! It's streaming a lot of content from HDD! So you need to have one with a good reading speed for a good performance.

Game:
- You can Start the Game with two modes (two icons). The second one gives the game a little extra effect by tilting the screen.
- On the Main screen, you can choose MUSIC ON/OFF by push the JOY (UP-DOWN).
You can Choose the Level you already completed (the progress is automatically saved) by pushing the JOY (LEFT-RIGHT) and press FIRE.
- Control with JOY or MOUSE.
- SHOOT enemies to gain SHIELD
-HAVE FUN! :)

EHB Version with HAM cutscenes:
For public suggestion, we tried to make a more colorful version. WARNING! This is a version that has more color, but because of that it is lager in size and need an even faster HDD than originally. For these reasons, we recommend the minimum requirements for this version is to run it on a Vampire. The zip files contains a pre-configured (WinFellow) emulator, with that you can instantly play it on Windows.

Anaglyph 3D version:
Just for fun, we made an Anaglyph stereo version of the trench run level! (This is just one level) This means that if you have RED-BLUE glasses, you can play the game in 3D (at least you will have the illusion of depth on the screen).

454699.overview: Unbeknown to Santa, was that whilst he was away, The Grunch broke into the toy factory at north pole and elfnapped the top four head elfs meaning all toy production stopped. The Grunch was happy. He could now take Christmas off as there were no more presents to steal!

455002.overview: Sapermania is a clone of Saper/Minesweeper for the Commodore Amiga, developed and released by Reborn80 on December 28, 2024.

455356.overview: Han Solo and Chewbacca are racing to the Kashyyyk planet to celebrate the Life Day with their family and friends. Unfortunatelly, Imperial Forces intercepted the Millenium Falcon and captured they on the detention block. Leia and C3PO received a help message from they and contacted Luke Skywalker. You are Luke Skywalker and your mission is to save Han and Chewie from the evil Imperial Forces to finally celebrate the Life Day.

456126.overview:
A collection of Shoot 'Em Up Construction kits developed and released by Darkm City Productions. The games included are:

- Space Wars 2
- Space Wars 3
- Space Wars 4

456216.overview: Sky Shapers in an engaging and challenging 50 FPS vertical scrolling SHMUP from the new Norwegian developers Digilicious Nibbles, with lots of charm due to its distinctive hand crafted graphics

456405.overview: Speed Haste is a 3D arcade racing game with 2 types of vehicles, and different cars per type: the famous F-1 and the Stock Cars (best known as Formula NASCAR), each with different characteristics and maneuverability. The player can compete in the championship mode, covering all circuits with an increasing difficulty, but identical for both car types. The multiplayer mode offers split-screen racing or IPX-based sessions with up to 4 players.A shareware racer gets an Amiga Port by BSzili

456972.overview: Published at the party RAM#3 demo compo

457095.overview: Control ship with joystick. Shoot with FIRE button. ESC quits game. You have limited fuel and ammunition. Your goal is to shoot enemy object (UFO). You'll get score for this.

457891.overview: Port of Street Fighter 1 for the Amiga 500 using the Scorpion Engine.

457898.overview: Porting of Shadow Dancer for the Amiga using Scorpion Engine.

458823.overview: Skinny Marley: The Waiter Dog is a relaxing, thoughtful puzzle game, inspired by Sokoban but with original mechanics and 10 progressively challenging levels.

458895.overview: Entry for AmigaWave and Posadas Party 2025

460595.overview: An interactive shooting game that takes place in outer space.

461978.overview:
In the year 2100, following World War III, survivors of the nuclear conflict face off in duels where each country is represented by a gladiator.

The contests take place in the Arena, a vast battlefield featuring mounds and hills.

At the start of each duel, six bombs are randomly placed within the Arena.

Each gladiator, maneuvering their vehicle, must collect the bombs and hurl them at their opponent.

The bombs travel at high speed, but the uneven terrain makes their trajectory unpredictable. The only way to emerge victorious is through quick reflexes and a great deal of luck.

Published in the May 1991 edition of AmigaMagazine OnDisk #23.

462401.overview:
I made this back in 2017 as a tribute to the Lukozer YouTube channel. It is a hacked version of the Amiga port of the Star Wars arcade game, with different text and speech.

V1.5 - This is the first version, with a main and alternative sound scape.

V2.0 - This is the second release, and I think I added a third soundscape, and a basic script to toggle them. This might also have a longer intro sample?

V2.0b - A bug fixed version of 2.0, but due to cramming too much in there, some of the samples seem clipped. This one also has an AGA backdrop if you have an AGA machine. If not, you can ignore the AGA warning.

The hack was officially released on October 2, 2025

462456.overview: The Settlers II is regarded as the pinnacle of the series and a milestone in the building strategy genre. The game perfected everything that made the first part awesome: the bustling inhabitants, the complex economic chains, and the unique charm. Now finally it’s where it belongs – on the Amiga.

463256.overview: Right now the build is a very very early technical demo, showing only the basic movement system.

463780.overview: In Santastic,  players assume  the role  of Santa  Claus, whose mission is to deliver presents to children awaiting gifts in various regions of a snowy landscape. Each level presents unique challenges,  hazards,  and  opportunities for discovery.

464559.overview:
An arcade style on-rails shooter where you play in single or two player cooperative mode using the Mouse/Mice or Light Gun.

Santa's Present Drop 5!

Poor Santa, at the end of part 4 last year, Santa managed to rescue his Elfs(TM) from the Grunch(TM), but on return to the north pole found his work shop overrun with zombie rabbits!

Playing as Santa or his head Elf, you must destroy all rabbit zombies so that toy production can continue.

464675.overview: Super Santa Copter is a Christmas-themed arcade game for the Amiga 500

464877.overview: I had the idea of trying to bring Sonic to the Amiga earlier this year, but with the current projects I had in the pipeline, I decided to put it on the back burner and revisit it sometime in the future.

469867.overview: This is the first release of our simple Tetris game, created for the Commodore and Amiga Encounter 2026.

470088.overview: Strike Force Omega is a fast, top‑down arcade shooter for AGA Amigas

470599.overview: This game is an adaptation of the semi-graphic Italian adventure 'Murray Shannon: I Semi del Male' by Bonaventura Di Bello. It was originally written using The Quill and Illustrator and published by Edizioni Hobby S.r.l. on the cover tape of 'Viking', no. 1, January 1987 for ZX Spectrum and C64.

472680.overview: Stunt Car Racer running at a super smooth 50/60fps

474185.overview: Created by Tim Moore as an homage to the TRON Lightcycle game, SPALG existed only in the memories of the lucky few who saw it during its original creation. Now, 31 years later, SPALG has finally been released to the world!

475989.overview: THE SECRET OF BARRON WOOD is a supernatural short story in the form of a text adventure.  Venture into the deep wood and explore its darkest recesses, where a century-old secret awaits your discovery.

478714.overview: a work-in-progress proof of concept for Shinobi (1989) on the Commodore Amiga 500

479480.overview: An Amiga 68k port of the best space RTS strategy game. The engine runs natively on AmigaOS 3.x — no PC emulation, no interpreter. Integer arithmetic only: the binary contains not one FPU instruction, because plenty of 68k machines have no FPU.

479813.overview: Classic public domain film starring darling star Harold Lloyd

479972.overview: Sparkpaw: The Stormstone Quest is an original side-scrolling action platformer for the Commodore Amiga 1200. Play as Sparkpaw, an amber-orange feline adventurer and young inventor armed with a teal energy gauntlet, and cross ancient stone-and-machine ruins to recover the scattered Cores of the Stormstone.

480056.overview:
This is a work-in-progress demo of my port of 'Sonic The Hedgehog' from the Sega Megadrive to the Commodore Amiga 1200. The port is entitled 'Aonic'.
It is directly based on the original code. Specifically, the disassembly published by the Sonic Retro team. As such, it plays identically, although the rendering has been heavily optimized and rewritten for the Amiga. Visually, there are necessary and obvious differences. This demo is the first Act of Green Hill Zone only. But architecturally I am scaling up to deliver the complete game. The major challenge isn't converting the code, but ensuring the engine is performant on a different architecture. Around 95% of the time spent on Aonic has been devising optimisations and rearchitecting the game to run at an acceptable frame-rate.

480369.overview: This is a Sargon II inspired chess engine for the Amiga. It has improved search, pondering, and has the option for a 512KB or 1MB hash table.

481012.overview: WIP point and click adventure.logical puzzles and stupid wit.

481303.overview: Sonic 060 is an unofficial fan made port of Sonic The Hedgehog for high end accelerated AGA Amigas. It was 100% vibe coded by me with Claude, and it is based on architecture, research and design choices made by reassembler and RetroRic of the Aonic project. To see the full details of each developer's contributions to Sonic 060 as well as how the training information was obtained please read credits.htm in the zipfile.

481307.overview: A native A1200 port of Timo Kauppinen's DOS shareware racing game Slicks 'N' Slide 1.51. The original 16-bit x86 game was recovered from its executable and rebuilt as native 68020 code: game and UI logic recovered into C and C++, with hot routines translated to hand-checked 68020 assembly, on a direct AGA/Paula platform layer. There is no x86 emulator and no generated-C CPU emulation; the original executable running under a PC reference emulator is the ground truth that every routine is tested against.

481421.overview:
Star Trek: 25th Anniversary was the first game of a two game adventure series from Interplay. This first part was released for Amiga AGA in the 1990ies.

The second part, Judgment Rites, was never released.

This download ist the interpreter to play this game on Amiga, with some more features.

481569.overview: You are a little, white rabbit; lost and hungry. You are in a garden and can smell carrots; once you've eaten one you want more and more. The problem is that the acorns will fall on your head and the squirrels and butterflies will attack you if you don't dodge them in time. Collect all the carrots before time runs out or you will starve.

481578.overview: You ride into Dusty Creek with the sun at your back and a Colt on your hip. The town is scared stiff: Bart Hollis and his gang come and go as they please, the sheriff can't stop them alone, and the bank's safe is next on their list.

481648.overview: Across three levels, you explore the ruins, fight hostile enemies, and piece together fragments of the planet’s past. Each level takes you further into the mystery, until you face a powerful final boss guarding the secret behind whatever is awakening below.

481713.overview:
LIFEFORCE (Konami 1986) - AGA Amiga port, V1.0
Ported to the Amiga by TjLaZer 2026

481790.overview: A conversion of Namco’s 1982 arcade game Super Pac-Man for the Amiga.  The upright arcade screen sits in the center, with scores, lives and the bonus fruit in side panels.

481801.overview: A demake of Super Hexagon on the Amiga, heavily inspired by the original game. Avoid the walls, and try not to blink.

481847.overview: Version 1.6.3. This release is primarily intended for emulation. It provides 50 Hz physics and rendering at up to 50 FPS, while lap timers retain their original 8.33 Hz update rate, and detects PAL or NTSC displays at boot. The achieved frame rate depends on the machine's Chip RAM access speed; game speed stays correct when frames are late. The patcher also writes a WHDLoad install of the same game for a hard disk.

481899.overview: You must pilot a spaceship (Final Star) over series series of islands - drifting in outer-space - shooting enemy spacecraft and ground-based targets. Special symbols appear at regular intervals and can be shot or collected for bonuses. The levels are designated by letters of the Greek alphabet.

481969.overview: Snake's Snack is a retro game developed in AMOS Professional by Alberto "BCO" Sgaggero for the legendary Commodore Amiga 500.

482023.overview:
ALCON comes to the Amiga

Take flight in this Amiga transcode of Alcon, also known as Slap Fight, the classic vertically scrolling arcade shoot ’em up.

Pilot your fighter through enemy territory, dodge incoming fire, and blast through waves of opposition. Collect stars and select upgrades to build your ship’s firepower as you chase a higher score.

482027.overview: Star Bashers is the third mini-game release from BlitterForge, featuring 9 levels and developed for a standard Commodore Amiga 1200 running Kickstart 3.0. The game requires no accelerator or additional memory and has also been successfully tested in WinUAE using Kickstart 3.1. Star Bashers is not intended to be a large or ambitious production, but rather a passion project that brings together retro computing, experimentation, modern AI-assisted development, and the joy of creating something new for a legendary platform.

482052.overview: Four knights, two cursed worlds and a demon who collects souls. Whoever finds the four Soul Stones first opens the portal to the Realm of Evil, and must face Soul Killa in the end.

482118.overview: Sopwith AGA brings the classic 1984 MS-DOS aerial combat game to the Commodore Amiga 1200, taking advantage of the machine's AGA chipset. Originally developed by David L. Clark for the Canadian company BMB Compuscience, Sopwith became one of the memorable early action games for IBM PC compatibles. Now, more than four decades after its original release, this little piece of gaming history has found a new home on the Amiga!

482167.overview:
Shinobi as it was on the PC Engine HuCard (Asmik, 1989), running natively on
the Amiga: the game's own code, converted to C from the original program,
plays exactly as the PC Engine version does, with graphics drawn by the
Amiga's blitter and copper, the game's music as Oktalyzer modules and its
sound effects as samples.

482168.overview: Two fields, falling columns of stones, one winner. Line up 3 or more equal symbols in any direction - horizontally, vertically or diagonally - and the stones shatter. Chain your matches and the rubble drops onto your opponent's field.

482170.overview:
Put on the mask. Enter the mansion. Bring Jennifer home.
Splatterhouse brings Namco’s horror action classic to Amiga AGA. This is a near 1-1 port of the PC Engine game for any AGA equipped Amiga, with USA and Japanese presentation and a newly arranged ProTracker soundtrack and bonus CD32 CDDA Music from both the PC Engine and Arcade version.

482217.overview:
Engine rewritten from scratch
Better graphics, ripped from PC-Engine
stages use 16 colors, optimised

482509.overview: Starwinder is a new vertical-scrolling shoot-'em-up for the AGA Amiga: A1200, A4000 and CD32.

482511.overview: Fly as an American or German pilot in the years 1943-1945 in this WWII air combat simulation. This game features several experimental German aircraft to try out. Can you alter the outcome of WWII with them? The experimental German planes include Messerschmitt 262, Me163 Komet rocket plane, and the Gotha "flying wing". You can also fly the traditional ME109 or FW190 piston engine aircraft.

482583.overview: Skate or Die DX brings the EA classic to the Amiga for the first time!

482627.overview: Shinobiz presents, with the help of Claude: a native conversion of the Atari ST version of Super Sprint (Electric Dreams, 1987) for the Commodore Amiga 500/1200.

482810.overview:
SPACE TAXI - Amiga ECS / AGA Remaster Remastered by TjLaZer 2026
Original C64 game (c) 1984 John F. Kutcher / Muse Software

482814.overview:
SENDESCHLUSS is a free point-and-click adventure for the Amiga 1200 with AGA.
Friday, 31 October 1986. The night shift. Jan Brenner presents "Brenner by Night" – music for insomniacs – from Broadcasting House on the Ring. Since midnight he has been alone in the building. Almost alone. At three fourteen the phone rings, and the voice on the line is his own.

482898.overview:
Stronkie's Snake for the Amiga 500: the Commodore 64 game ported to 68000 machine code, with the same levels, rules and scoring, and Amiga graphics and sound.
Created By Mark Stronks (Stronkie), programmed by Claude. Menu music: "Cool Tune" by Charles Deenen (1987).
